summary: The warehouse-coldchain-charge-review task validated cold chain shipping charge requests against carrier registry, shipment authorizations, and snapshot history. It involved PDF extraction from charge packets, Excel multi-sheet reading (carriers + aliases), CSV processing for authorizations with state filtering (approved only), snapshot revision handling (highest approved snapshot for amount), and carrier-shipment ownership validation. The multi-source-reconciliation skill already covers this pattern comprehensively - this task is essentially a direct application with carrier/shipment terminology instead of employee/trip or provider/order. The key novel elements are: (1) snapshot-based revision handling where empty amounts are skipped, (2) 'draft' state filtering in both authorizations and snapshots, (3) carrier-shipment ownership validation (like Entity-Reference Mismatch), (4) temperature_band as an additional carrier attribute. Rather than create a duplicate skill, I'll extend the existing multi-source-reconciliation skill with a new known invariant for this pattern and add a reference doc covering snapshot/revision handling patterns.
